description: Land Acquisition - Kopay Valikamam East D/S Division, Jaffna District - Amendment Ex. Gaz. No. 2355/43 dated 26.10.2023, Kuchchaveli D/S DIvision
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific notices about government acquisition of particular land parcels for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of the lands, claimants, and compensation procedures. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative actions without involving government personnel changes, structural reforms, or other specialized categories.
